disposition_reason: Table 2 prints ranges of mercury, arsenic, nickel and tin in 32 raw cow milk samples from industrial and traditional farms around Arak, Iran.

study.design: Cross-sectional survey of raw cow milk from industrial and traditional dairy farms
study.origin: four sub-cities of Arak City, Markazi Province, central Iran (polluted industrial city)
study.method: 25 g dry ashing at 450 C, HNO3 dissolution; graphite furnace AAS (Varian AA230, GTA 340)
study.qa: No CRM, recovery or LOD reported

findings.group: traditional and industrial dairy farms, Arak sub-cities, Markazi Province, Iran
findings.notes: Range over 32 samples (16 industrial, 16 traditional farms); farm-type means are figure-only (Figure 1). Per-litre result (µg/L); not converted to µg/kg.
